GAP-001.title: Sale Line Items Lack Barcode, SKU & Point-in-Time Cost Snapshot Persistence
GAP-001.acceptance_criteria: When product master name/price is modified after sale, re-fetching sale details returns point-in-time snapshot unaltered.

GAP-002.title: Product Master Schema Lacks Authoritative Wholesale Pricing Tier Column
GAP-002.acceptance_criteria: Creating or updating product with wholesale_price persists value and returns it in catalog API and POS cart.

GAP-003.title: Split-Tender Multi-Method Payment Allocations Lack Dedicated Breakdown Persistence
GAP-003.acceptance_criteria: Split cash + card payment creates separate ledger entries in CashLedger and AccountMovement matching exact split amounts.

GAP-004.title: Inventory Physical Count Stock Adjustment Bypasses Valuation Adjustment Account
GAP-004.acceptance_criteria: When stock quantity is reduced via adjustment, an AccountMovement record is created against Inventory Loss Account.

GAP-005.title: Purchase Freight & Landed Costs Not Capitalized Into Product Moving Average Cost
GAP-005.acceptance_criteria: When freight amount is entered on purchase receiving, purchase_items.unit_cost reflects prorated cost + freight.

GAP-006.title: Purchase Cancellation Does Not Verify If Received Stock Has Already Been Sold
GAP-006.acceptance_criteria: Attempting to cancel purchase when quantity_on_hand < received_quantity returns HTTP 422 with clear error message.

GAP-007.title: Inter-Branch Stock Transfer Operates Synchronously Without In-Transit Clearing State
GAP-007.acceptance_criteria: Transfer creates IN_TRANSIT record; destination branch stock only increases after explicit receiveTransfer API call.

GAP-008.title: Modifying Customer ID on Posted Sale Creates Silent Khata Ledger Drift
GAP-008.acceptance_criteria: Attempting to update customer_id on posted sale returns HTTP 422 Unprocessable Entity.

GAP-009.title: Customer Payment Reversal Lacks Guard Against Secondary Over-Collection Reversal Race
GAP-009.acceptance_criteria: Repeated customer payment reversal requests reject duplicate execution with HTTP 409 Conflict.

GAP-010.title: Sale Return Workflow Lacks Granular Restock Condition / Scrap Decision Flag
GAP-010.acceptance_criteria: When is_restockable is false, branch_inventories quantity_on_hand does not increase; item logged to inventory_movements as DAMAGED_SCRAP.

GAP-011.title: Missing Dedicated Supplier Return / Debit Note Workflow With Stock Reversal & AP Deduction
GAP-011.acceptance_criteria: Creating supplier return decrements branch inventory and reduces supplier current_balance by exact return value.

GAP-012.title: Supplier Payment Mutation Lacks Automated Reversal Mechanism With AP Re-Accrual
GAP-012.acceptance_criteria: POST /api/v1/supplier-payments/{id}/reverse marks payment REVERSED and re-accrues supplier AP balance.

GAP-013.title: Operating Expense Entry Allows Null Financial Account Creating Unallocated Cash Drift
GAP-013.acceptance_criteria: Attempting to create expense without valid financial_account_id fails validation with HTTP 422.

GAP-014.title: Soft-Deleting Operating Expense Leaves Associated AccountMovement Row Active
GAP-014.acceptance_criteria: When expense is deleted/voided, associated AccountMovement is reversed and financial account balance restored.

GAP-015.title: UI-Only Authorization for High-Risk Destructive Operations Lacks Backend Policy Enforcement
GAP-015.acceptance_criteria: Salesperson attempting to cancel sale or void expense receives HTTP 403 Forbidden.

GAP-016.title: Implicit Route Model Binding Queries Records Across Tenants Before ResolveActiveBusiness Scope
GAP-016.acceptance_criteria: Attempting to fetch resource ID belonging to another business returns HTTP 404 Not Found.

GAP-017.title: Sale Store Endpoint Accepts Arbitrary branch_id In Request Payload Without User Assignment Check
GAP-017.acceptance_criteria: Sale creation strictly restricts branch_id to cashier assigned branch_id unless authorized as Business Owner.

GAP-018.title: Server Trusts Client-Calculated Sale Totals & Discounts Without Server Recalculation
GAP-018.acceptance_criteria: Sale creation rejects payloads where sum(items.total) - discount + tax != total with HTTP 422.

GAP-019.title: Sale Return Refund Settlement Endpoint Lacks Client Request UUID Deduplication
GAP-019.acceptance_criteria: Repeated refund settlement calls with same idempotency_key return identical single transaction response without double debit.

GAP-020.title: Purchase GRN Receiving Lacks Pessimistic Row Lock on branch_inventories
GAP-020.acceptance_criteria: Parallel execution of 10 sales and 10 receipts on same product yields exact mathematical net balance.

GAP-021.title: POS Checkout Dispatches Thermal Receipt Printing Before Verified HTTP Commit Confirmation
GAP-021.acceptance_criteria: Thermal print dispatch executes strictly inside .then() block after confirmed HTTP commit or localDb outbox write.

GAP-022.title: Offline POS Terminals Lack Distributed Stock Reservations Permitting Inventory Double-Spend
GAP-022.acceptance_criteria: When bulk sync ingests sales causing stock < 0, an audit log entry event=inventory_oversold is created with notifications.

GAP-023.title: Offline Customer Khata Balance Projection Displays Stale Balance During Concurrent Online Settlements
GAP-023.acceptance_criteria: When navigator.onLine is false, customer dropdown in POS displays warning badge with last synced timestamp.

GAP-024.title: Peer-to-Peer Device Pairing Service Lacks IP Address & Private Subnet Boundary Validation
GAP-024.acceptance_criteria: Scanning QR with non-RFC1918 IP rejects connection with "Invalid Local Subnet IP" error toast.

GAP-025.title: Offline Quick Customer Creation Lacks Persistent Temp-to-Server ID Mapping Graph
GAP-025.acceptance_criteria: Bulk sync payload containing new customer UUID and sale referencing same UUID ingests customer first and correctly links sale.

GAP-026.title: Critical Destructive Mutations Lack Explicit Modal Confirmation Dialogs
GAP-026.acceptance_criteria: Clicking destructive action opens modal with Cancel and Confirm buttons; API call fires only upon Confirm.

GAP-027.title: POS Screen Lacks Persistent Active Operating Branch & Shift Indicator in Header
GAP-027.acceptance_criteria: POS screen header prominently displays active branch name, active cashier, and connectivity badge at all times.

GAP-028.title: Legacy Unrouted ProductInvoiceView Component Creates Codebase Confusion
GAP-028.acceptance_criteria: Unrouted invoice component replaced with standard printable preview modal integrated with printerService.js.

GAP-029.title: Employee HR Wage, Salary Amount & Payment Cycle Discarded Without Database Schema Persistence
GAP-029.acceptance_criteria: Saving staff user with salary_amount and payment_cycle persists values and returns them on user profile API.

GAP-030.title: Customer Secondary Phone & Alternate Contact Number Discarded Without Schema Persistence
GAP-030.acceptance_criteria: Creating or updating customer with secondary_phone persists value in database and IndexedDB cache.

GAP-031.title: Expense Category Monthly Budget Cap Limit Discarded Without Schema Persistence
GAP-031.acceptance_criteria: Expense category creation with monthly_budget stores decimal value and displays budget cap on expense summary dashboard.
